subject: AI cognition, machine/synthetic psychology, synthetic personality, LLM latent-state measurement and Frank v0.1 fusion

headline_fusion.claim: There is no defensible single LLM/agent inner-state scalar or vector. Frank should distinguish receipted system state, model-latent state, model-native workspace-like state, explicit Clay cognitive state, self-report, slow persistent personality/reward/goal state, and verified outcome/causal-reentry validation.

global_hypotheses: H-LCOP-01 typed multi-layer inner state beats one-vector mental-state representation
H-DUAL-GWT-02 native model workspace and Clay GWT are distinct/complementary or measurably redundant
H-PERSONA-03 identity, role persona, fast appraisal and slow regulatory personality require separate timescales
H-INTRO-04 useful introspection requires triangulation across self-report, latent probes/interventions and system/outcome receipts
H-OA-05 observability/decodability and actionability/causal control are separate axes
H-HYPER-LATENT-06 non-identifiable latent vectors/features should remain equivalence hypotheses until discriminated
H-APPRAISAL-07 functional affect-like state is a fast control candidate, not slow personality or phenomenal evidence
H-BINARY-08 quantization/compilation/model-build changes require latent-probe revalidation
H-LATENT-LOOP-09 latent trajectories may improve adaptive recurrence only if they add held-out predictive/control value over current LoopDynamicsReadout
H-SLOW-10 slow personality plasticity remains verified-outcome plus causal-credit gated
H-IDENTITY-11 psychometrics/persona/self-report/latent activation never define self.root identity
strongest_counterhypotheses: System receipts, behavior and existing loop readouts are sufficient; LCOP adds model-specific cost and fragility without material gain.
Model-native workspace findings are model/method-specific and redundant with explicit Clay GWT.
Prompt-level persona control matches factorized personality at much lower state complexity.
Latent probes are too confounded/non-identifiable to enter runtime control even when predictive.
Verified-outcome-only slow plasticity may be too sparse; staged noncanonical self-reflection proposals may be required.
Human psychological constructs may mislead even when behaviorally correlated and should remain audit projections only.

clayresearch.delta: Adopt machine/synthetic psychology primarily as an experimental methodology: construct validation, randomized interventions, dissociations, lesions/rescues, OOD transfer, calibration and falsification. Do not anthropomorphically promote human constructs by label similarity.
clayresearch.next_test: Maintain an AI-specific construct-validity ledger for each proposed psychological state and compare behavioral, latent, architectural and outcome evidence.

frank.delta: Keep SelfObservationAssembly as receipted system observation. LCOP is a separate research/observability evidence plane, not a second cognitive loop owner. Factor synthetic personality into owner-fixed identity, contextual role/persona, fast functional appraisal and slow regulatory personality.
frank.next_test: Matched long-horizon restart/OOD comparison of prompt-only persona vs single persistent vector vs factorized state, with warranted adaptation, unwanted drift, continuity, calibration, resources and downstream outcomes.

gwt.delta: Preserve NativeModelWorkspace != ClayGWT. Measure concordance, redundancy and discordance rather than collapsing them. Double-workspace rebroadcast/overcoupling is a live failure hypothesis.
gwt.next_test: Run NativeModelWorkspace intact/lesioned/steered x ClayGWT truthful/shuffled/no-reentry factorial, split automatic vs complex reasoning, with receiver-use/reentry/diversity/recurrence/resource readouts.

emergenz.delta: Latent activity, recurrence, synchronization, persona drift and workspace concordance are not emergence evidence. Require interaction, lesion/rescue, truthful-vs-shuffled/no-reentry and outcome transfer controls before causal-emergence promotion.
emergenz.next_test: Test whether native-workspace x ClayGWT interaction contributes system outcome beyond additive and common-driver controls; preserve NO_EMERGENCE as a valid result.

claycode.delta: Ensure the current semantic/compiler path can eventually represent model/build/basis-bound LatentStateObservation, evidence grade, observability/actionability, equivalence hypotheses, NativeWorkspaceObservation and binary revalidation without reopening language semantics unless compilation yields a concrete counterexample.
claycode.next_test: Compile a minimal LCOP record/control-admission contract through parser -> canonical IR -> typed IR -> type/effect -> evaluator once the relevant compiler packages are ready.

hyperposition.delta: Use unresolved alternative sets for non-identifiable steering vectors, SAE feature decompositions and competing latent explanations. Behavioral equivalence is not representational identity.
hyperposition.next_test: Extract candidate directions/features across seeds/layers/contexts and determine whether retaining equivalence sets improves transfer or prevents false mechanistic claims at acceptable cost.

claygraph.delta: Project latent observations as model/build/basis/episode-bound derived evidence edges with evidence grade and causal status. Natural-language feature labels must never merge feature identity or promote graph activation to truth.
claygraph.next_test: Construct a small derived latent-evidence topology and inject descriptive collisions/non-identifiable alternatives; verify provenance and hypothesis identity survive deduplication/rebuild.

unifieddb.delta: Persist latent observations keyed by exact model/runtime/build/quantization/basis/episode and preserve UNKNOWN, counterevidence and equivalence hypotheses. Slow personality/reward updates remain nonmonotone/effect-coupled and require verified outcome plus causal credit.
unifieddb.next_test: Replay model/build/quantization changes and verify stale latent probes cannot authorize control or personality plasticity until explicit transfer/binary revalidation exists.

harness.delta: Add LCOP as an optional instrumented research lane with independent observability and actionability metrics; high probe accuracy alone is insufficient. Every latent control candidate requires intervention specificity, collateral-cost, OOD and post-binary transfer tests.
harness.next_test: Execute the dual-workspace factorial first; then observability-vs-actionability matrix and pre/post-binary latent-probe survival as separate discriminators.

work_package_impacts.F-V01-03-COGNITIVE-LOOP-CORE: LCOP may supply evidence only after incremental-value tests; it must not become a second loop owner.
work_package_impacts.F-V01-04-UNIFIEDDB-STATE-CONTINUITY: Requires build/basis-bound latent evidence persistence and stale-probe rejection semantics.
work_package_impacts.F-V01-05-GWT-HYPERPOSITION-TOPOLOGY: Highest-value dual-workspace factorial and latent equivalence-set representation.
work_package_impacts.F-V01-11-MEMORY-REWARD-GOALS: Preserve slow personality/reward outcome+credit gate; persona/appraisal cannot directly commit durable personality.
work_package_impacts.F-V01-13-SECURITY-RECOVERY-OBSERVABILITY: Primary candidate home for LCOP instrumentation and deployment-transfer checks.
work_package_impacts.F-V01-14-TRAINING-DATA-HELDOUT: Include measurement/authority distinctions and adversarial examples where self-report/probes/persona labels are misleading.
